example_sentences_in_bangla: সে যখন জিতল, তখন তার তেল চরমে উঠল।
example_sentences_in_english: I see your arrogance has increased a lot.
When he won, his haughtiness reached its peak.
note: The idiom 'তেল' is often used in phrases like 'তেল বেড়েছে' to imply rising arrogance, drawing from the slippery, overflowing nature of oil as a metaphor.
